summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K furnishing a corrective Oslo Børs stock announcement on its employee share-based incentive buy-back. The programme, announced 4 February 2026, runs 13 February 2026 to 15 January 2027, totalling NOK 1,971,000,000 and a maximum 19,600,000 shares. On 15 September 2026 Equinor repurchased 379,361 own shares at a weighted average NOK 419.1253, bringing cumulative buy-backs to 3,778,442 shares for NOK 1,302,847,119. Treasury holdings reached 19,798,825 shares, 0.83% of capital. The correction fixes previously misstated totals; watch remaining programme capacity and any share-capital cancellation.
